feeds.title: SMART Recovery Blog
feeds.description: SMART Recovery is the leading self-empowering addiction recovery support group helping people recover from addiction to harmful substances and behaviors. Check out the latest news and people's stories on addiction recovery, experts' insights and more!

feeds.title: Cathy Taughinbaugh Blog
feeds.description: Cathy Taughinbaugh helps parents of young adults struggling with substance use and find ways to help their child recover through coaching & an online course.

feeds.title: This Naked Mind Blog
feeds.description: Packed with insightful science-based information, practical tips, and incredible stories of people just like you, this blog is our little corner of the internet designed to uplift you, make you smile, and give you hope! Annie Grace the founder of This Naked Mind, approaches people with solutions that help people where rehabs have not.

feeds.title: SHE RECOVERS Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The SHE RECOVERS Foundation is a non-profit public charity with a growing and evolving community currently consisting of more than 325,000 women in or seeking recovery from substance use disorders, other behavioral health issues, and/or life challenges. For news about upcoming events & retreats, new products, amazing articles and so much more in our blog.

feeds.title: Narconon Blog
feeds.description: Narconon provides drug rehabilitation, drug education and drug prevention programs that have helped millions improve their lives. Follow this blog to get information on drug education and prevention.

feeds.title: MedMark Blog
feeds.description: MedMark Treatment Centers, a BayMark Health Services Company, provides outpatient medication-assisted treatment for opioid addiction utilizing methadone and buprenorphine. Our evidence-based treatment is supported by substance abuse counseling, case management, community resource referrals, and other supportive services to help patients reclaim their lives. For all of the latest news and information involving medication-assisted treatment, substance abuse counseling, and opioid addiction, check out our blog.

feeds.title: Partnership to End Addiction
feeds.description: The nation's one of the leading organizations dedicated to addiction prevention, treatment, and recovery, we are a diverse community of researchers, advocates, clinicians, communicators, and more. We're on a mission to transform how our nation addresses addiction by empowering families, advancing effective care, shaping public policy, and changing culture.

feeds.title: Gateway Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Gateway Foundation is the largest nonprofit treatment provider with programs. It offers a full continuum of care across a wide range of clinical settings, so no matter where a patient is in life or recovery, we have a program that can be personalized for them. It's care that stays for life.

feeds.title: Granite Recovery
feeds.description: Granite Recovery Centers offers primary treatment and extended care sober living for men and women recovering from substance use disorders.

feeds.title: High Focus Centers Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest from Rehab After Work, a recovery advocate with Pennsylvania and New Jersey locations specializing in adult and teen substance use treatment. Rehab After Work is a licensed intensive outpatient drug and alcohol treatment program. It provides individualized treatment programs so people can get the help that they need on an outpatient basis and continue to work.

feeds.title: Briarwood Detox Blog » Drug Addiction
feeds.description: Briarwood Detox's mission is to provide safe and comfortable medical detox programs that stabilize each client so they are both physically and mentally prepared to participate in the next stage of recovery. On our blog, we cover a wide variety of topics on drug addiction. What to expect, withdrawal symptoms, and how to get proper treatment.

feeds.title: The Right Step Blog
feeds.description: Browse The Right Step rehab blog to learn more about addiction treatment in the news including today's trending addiction information. The Right Step family of addiction treatment centers offers a full continuum of alcohol and drug rehab programs. These include a medically monitored detox center in Texas to residential and outpatient drug rehab programs.

feeds.title: Addiction Treatment Forum
feeds.description: Addiction Treatment Forum reports on substance abuse news of interest to opioid treatment programs and patients in medication-assisted treatment.

feeds.title: Footprints to Recovery Drug Treatment Blog
feeds.description: Footprints to Recovery Drug Treatment Blog is dedicated to drug and alcohol addiction and treatment rehabilitation with advice and information from authoritative experts in the industry. Our mission is to provide the education, tools, and support for individuals, families, and the community to find the reason to achieve lasting recovery and a life lived to the fullest potential.

feeds.title: Beachside Blog
feeds.description: Beachside is a beautiful luxury rehab with amazing accommodations on the beach to recover from drugs, and or alcohol addiction. Follow our blog to learn more about the various types of addiction and the tips and advice our trained staff provide to help overcome substance abuse.

feeds.title: Alpine Recovery Lodge Blog
feeds.description: The Alpine Recovery Lodge blog provides the latest news and information about various treatments and recovery from alcohol and drug abuse.

feeds.title: An Addict In Our Son's Bedroom
feeds.description: We want to welcome you to our blog. This blog is principally going to be about parenting a drug addict. However as parents of drug addicts know they take up about 85% of your time, worry, and stress, but there are other good things going on too. My wish and goal for this blog are that maybe we can help you or you can help us.

feeds.title: Canadian Addiction Treatment Centres Blog
feeds.description: Useful resource for those who need help with drug addiction. Information about what drug addiction is and some advice on how to recover and get treatment. We aim to help people with addiction and drug problem to regain their lives and careers.

feeds.title: Addiction Unscripted
feeds.description: Addiction Unscripted aims to pull the covers back on the true world of addiction and recovery. Your source for addiction recovery news,rehab reviews and other resources. Follow this site to get news, articles, information on alcohol addiction and substance abuse.

feeds.title: Untipsyteacher
feeds.description: I am a retired teacher who quit drinking and found happiness! After going deaf, I now have two cochlear implants! I'm sharing my story in hopes it might help someone today.

feeds.title: Behavioral Crossroads Blog
feeds.description: Follow this page for important information on our blog about drug abuse and addiction. Behavioral Crossroads is a dually licensed behavioral services agency that provides a full range of services for substance abuse treatment, including drug rehab treatment, alcohol addiction treatment programs, as well as mental health interventions.

feeds.title: The Raleigh House Blog
feeds.description: The Raleigh House is a safe and nurturing Denver drug rehabilitation center offering holistic addiction treatment programs.

feeds.title: Drug Addiction Support Blog
feeds.description: This blog discusses news and current topics about drug addiction. Its goal is to help you understand the problems and issues related to drug addiction and recovery. The key to dealing with drug addiction is the right information. If you've ever wondered how drug addition impacts your life this site is for you.

feeds.title: Motivation & Change
feeds.description: The Center for Motivation & Change (CMC) is a group practice of dedicated clinicians and researchers who rely on science and kindness to help people change. We employ respectful, flexible, evidence-based approaches to address substance use and compulsive behavior problems as well as other mental health issues, including trauma.

feeds.title: Sober Senorita Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kelly Fitzgerald Junco. I am a Certified Coach, writer, and creator. My mission is to encourage everyone to live their truth, to break the stigma of addiction, to let others know help is available for substance use disorders, and that you do not have to suffer in silence.

feeds.title: Understanding Addiction
feeds.description: Marc Lewis, Ph.D., is a neuroscientist and professor of developmental psychology. He has authored or co-authored more than fifty journal articles in neuroscience and developmental psychology. Presently, he speaks and blogs on topics in addiction science.

feeds.title: UnPickled
feeds.description: My name is Jean, and I am UnPickled. I am learning to walk without the crutch of alcohol. I began writing this blog on my first day of sobriety. I drank quietly in private and have managed to quit just as privately. I didn't stay quiet about it, though. My story is all here. The purpose of this blog is to help make me accountable and, as it turns out, to encourage others along the way.

feeds.title: Sober Nation » Addiction & Recovery
feeds.description: The Recovery Blog on Sober Nation provides drug, alcohol addiction resources, drug addiction news, facts, personal stories and more. Sober Nation is a national resource center and online community for people seeking recovery from drug and alcohol addiction.

feeds.title: Addictions.com
feeds.description: The addictions.com blog is your trusted source for information, breaking news, research, and inspirational recovery stories about drug and alcohol addiction. If you're looking for honest information related to mental health or drug and alcohol addiction, addictions.com is your #1 resource.

feeds.title: Breaking the Cycles Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Frederiksen founded Breaking The Cycles.com to provide education, prevention, and intervention services on a range of addiction* and other mental health disorders-related topics anchored in breakthrough 21st-century brain and scientific research.

feeds.title: The Clearing Residential Treatment Center Blog
feeds.description: The Clearing is an innovative residential treatment Program focused on addressing the underlying core issues which fuel substance abuse, depression, anxiety, and other challenges to our mental health. Follow this blog and get articles on addiction recovery, how to stay clean, breaking addictions, and self-healing through spiritual practices.

feeds.title: Recovery Connection Blog
feeds.description: Recovery Connection specializes in the treatment of addiction by providing quality care to those suffering from drug and alcohol abuse.

feeds.title: Midwood Addiction Treatment Blog
feeds.description: We are the premiere substance abuse treatment provider of Charlotte offering a unique opportunity to gain freedom from the bondage's of addiction.

feeds.title: Hi, my name is Sara and I am a drug addict.....
feeds.description: I was in my thirties when I got addicted to drugs. Life hadn't been incredibly kind to me and I was desperate for a purpose. I have lived an interesting and unconventional life. I truly appreciate all of my experiences both good and bad. I am very open-minded and appreciated like-minded people. Kindness is important to me. I am drawn to confident people who know and own who they are.

feeds.title: The Miracle of the Mundane
feeds.description: Welcome to my web write-space. I'm Mark David Goodson. My poetry, essays, and creative non-fiction exalt every day and qualify the quotidian. Writing has made being sober more than just being sober. I invite you to follow this blog and connect with me on social media - to join me in discovering what makes the ordinary so extraordinary, and the mundane miraculous.

feeds.title: Laura McKowen
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laura. I write a lot about addiction, sobriety, relationships, midlife, mothering, and change. My blog here has many years' worth of posts chronicling my years getting sober and learning how to live but I don't post there often anymore.

feeds.title: Family Secrets Exposed
feeds.description: My story covers many years and so it is a long story. These are secrets I have kept for various reasons, mostly for my children's sake. It is the time for me to reveal and release the secrets I kept about my abusers including substance abuse, parental alienation, gas lighting, stalking and assault (both sexual and physical).

feeds.title: The Privileged Addict
feeds.description: The Privileged Addict is a forum about addiction, recovery, spiritual growth.

feeds.title: Served Up Sober Blog
feeds.description: Served Up Sober is a San Diego-based community organization devoted to dismantling the stigma that surrounds addiction and mental health. We offer workshops + support tools + community for the sober and sober curious. A blog about addiction, sobriety, and a holistic recovery from drugs and alcohol.

feeds.title: 12 Keys Rehab Blog
feeds.description: We are committed to being the best recovery center for helping you beat your addiction .

feeds.title: The Unruffled Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sondra Primeaux and I'm a mom, a wife, a sister, a daughter, a maker, and an idealist. The Unruffled explores the ways we use creativity to help fuel recovery. We offer stories and photos of artists, makers, and writers in recovery and creative ideas on the blog.

feeds.title: Mrs D Is Going Without
feeds.description: I'm Lotta Dann. I used to be a boozy housewife. Now I'm not. This is my blog. I write books and blogs and promote recovery.

feeds.title: Sober Julie
feeds.description: I am Julie, a wife, and mother who also happens to be a recovering alcoholic. I began this blog as a journal of my life in 2010, after facing my alcoholism and soon after being in a serious car accident prevented me from performing the role in my corporate position.

feeds.title: Trump Drugs
feeds.description: I am a Professional Drug Addict. Searching for a way to help stop homelessness. When I was in rehab there were 2 homeless people in there, who ran in some trouble at the town's gazebo. Which is where all the Homeless hang out, so I made them a sober gazebo there. Just get out of the way while we clean this up. Because numerous addicts have died a true hero in battling this disease.

feeds.title: Rehabs.com Blog
feeds.description: Uncover the world of behavioral and drug addiction at the Rehabs.com blog. We cover drug rehabilitation news and feature unique and engaging editorial. We have been helping people connect with addiction treatment programs, achieve sobriety, and sustain recovery for over 20 years. Follow this blog and get drug rehabilitation news and articles.

feeds.title: Beginnings Treatment Centers Blog
feeds.description: Our Addiction Treatment Blog features informative articles, important news, and other interesting information about all aspects of addiction.
